# Where and when

This module is meets in-person [Tuesday 16:00 - 17:00 and Thursday 16:00 - 18:00](https://timetable.ucl.ac.uk/modules/STAT0041?year=2026-2027)


# Course content

- Introduction to algorithms and asymptotic analysis
- Sorting
- Introduction to data structures
- Search algorithms
- Dijkstra's algorithm
- Combinatorial optimization
- Computational linear algebra
- Additional topics

Some unifying concepts include: divide and conquer, dynamical programming, greedy algorithms, and randomization.


# Formal assessments 

* Summer exam: 3/4
* ICA group work: 1/4 (Due in 2027)
